i.norm: Shape used for the test: 17 hash functions (k) over 72 bits (m).

Merging an empty IndexExtractor (no indices) must leave the filter empty. This guards the case where the merge sets the internal cardinality to -1 yet no bits are actually enabled, so {@code isEmpty()} must still report true.
